description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Jinx''' fires a massive rocket in the target direction, briefly granting [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] of its surroundings and exploding upon colliding with an enemy champion. The explosion deals physical damage to nearby enemies and grants [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] of the area for 2 seconds.
description.text: Active: Jinx fires a massive rocket in the target direction, briefly granting sight of its surroundings and exploding upon colliding with an enemy champion. The explosion deals physical damage to nearby enemies and grants sight of the area for 2 seconds.

description2.raw: ''Super Mega Death Rocket!'' deals 10% – 100% (based on distance traveled)[[Category:Debug]] damage. This does not affect the '''bonus''' damage based on the target's '''missing''' health.

description3.raw: Enemies surrounding the primary target take 80% damage. The '''bonus''' damage based on the target's '''missing''' health is capped at 1200 against [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monsters]].

notes.raw: * [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|Spell shield]] will not prevent the explosion. * ''Super Mega Death Rocket's'' projectile has an [[File:Super Mega Death Rocket! Minimap.png|40px|link=]] icon on the mini-map while it is in flight. It can be seen by only '''Jinx''' and her allies. * The bonus damage based on missing health is based on each unit's own missing health and not the primary target's. * Unlike similar spells, ''Super Mega Death Rocket'' will not increase it's damage when ranked up while the missile is in flight.(unexpected) ** This is because the base damage is fixed at a multiple of the damage the rocket initially started with. ** The '''bonus''' AD ratio will still update when AD is gained or lost between the cast and hit of the missile. * This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the start of the cast time.
notes.text:
Spell shield will not prevent the explosion.
Super Mega Death Rocket's projectile has an icon on the mini-map while it is in flight. It can be seen by only Jinx and her allies.
The bonus damage based on missing health is based on each unit's own missing health and not the primary target's.
Unlike similar spells, Super Mega Death Rocket will not increase it's damage when ranked up while the missile is in flight.(unexpected)
* This is because the base damage is fixed at a multiple of the damage the rocket initially started with.
* The bonus AD ratio will still update when AD is gained or lost between the cast and hit of the missile.
This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the start of the cast time.
